topic: Team resource allocation and project priorities
summary_markdown: A discussion occurred regarding low productivity issues, which were determined not to be related to motivation or PTSD. Regarding a specific project, someone stated they could work on it if it was a high priority but preferred working on general tasks within the IT team rather than focusing solely on one area. The consensus reached was to address the recipient's problems generally and not assign them exclusively to another person.
decisions: Low productivity issues are not attributed to motivation or PTSD.
The focus will be placed on addressing general issues for the recipient, avoiding single-person assignment.
